mechanisms.name: stacking fault energy reduction by Co

evidence.quote: The high concentration of Co (about 15 wt.%) in the four alloys may effectively reduce the stacking fault energy (SFE) of the face centered cubic (FCC) structured γ matrix. This might be responsible for the good ductility below 850 °C and relatively low ductility above 850 °C

mechanisms.name: dislocation slip and superdislocation shearing of γ′ precipitates

evidence.quote: at RT-750 ◦C, the samples fail after continuous work hardening, which might be related to the dislocation slip in the matrix and superdislocation shearing of γ′ precipitates
